name: In The Dark
source:
You've had a recurring dream that clouds your vision and disconnects you from reality. 

She is a girl you have never seen and although the idea of seeing her in person is a frustrated desire, sometimes what we want is more than we can cope with. 

Shoji Suzuki is one of the many officers of the assault squad, who accompany detective Yamato Inoue in his investigation to stop a gang of bloody criminals, but the mission will not be so simple because tonight they will be involved in an event that transcends their kind and should remain a secret forever.

[From [url=https://spicy-marmalade-studio.itch.io/in-the-dark]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你经常做一个梦，它会遮蔽你的视野，使你与现实脱节。

她是一个你从未见过的女孩，虽然亲自见到她的想法令人沮丧，但有时我们想要的东西超出了我们的承受能力。

铃木正司是突击队的众多警官之一，他们陪同侦探井上大和进行调查，以阻止一伙血腥犯罪分子，但任务不会那么简单，因为今晚他们将卷入一场超越他们同类的事件，应该永远保密。

[来自[url=https://spicy-marmalade-studio.itch.io/in-the-dark]Itch.io[/url]]
